stories.title: La Policía acordona varias zonas del Congreso después de que una diputada del PP llevara un bote de gas pimienta al hemiciclo

en.title: Police cordon off several areas of Congress after PP deputy brought pepper spray canister to chamber
en.summary: A PP parliamentary member displayed pepper spray during a government control session, prompting the Congress president to order her removal and police to secure multiple areas of the building.

stories.title: Los Mossos detienen en Madrid a la pareja del arquitecto Josep Juanpere por su muerte en Baqueira el pasado diciembre

en.title: Mossos arrest partner of architect Josep Juanpere in Madrid over his death in Baqueira last December
en.summary: Catalan police arrested the former partner of architect Josep Juanpere, whose body was found dead at his residence in Baqueira in December. Initial reports attributed his death to natural causes, but police subsequently opened an investigation.

stories.title: Bronca en en Congreso: Armengol hace abandonar el hemiciclo a una diputada del PP por llevar un espray de pimienta

en.title: Uproar in Congress: Armengol orders PP deputy to leave chamber for carrying pepper spray
en.summary: Congress president Francina Armengol expelled a PP deputy from the chamber after she displayed pepper spray during a government control session to illustrate security concerns in Ceuta.

stories.title: Armengol expulsa momentáneamente del Pleno a una diputada del PP que exhibió un bote de gas pimienta, acusándola de "portar un arma"

en.title: Armengol temporarily expels PP deputy from chamber after she displayed pepper spray canister, accusing her of carrying a weapon
en.summary: A PP deputy was removed from the Congress chamber after displaying a pepper spray canister during a session. She later surrendered the item at a police station, and bathroom facilities in the Congress building were sealed following a suspected gas discharge.

stories.title: Trump and Delcy Rodríguez seal thaw with meeting in New York

en.title: Trump and Delcy Rodríguez seal thaw with meeting in New York
en.summary: Venezuela's leader met with Trump in New York during his UN speech, marking the first meeting between a US president and a Chavista leader since Clinton met Chávez in 1999.

stories.title: Detienen en Madrid a la pareja del arquitecto Josep Juanpere, muerto en Baqueira en diciembre del pasado año

en.title: Partner of architect Josep Juanpere arrested in Madrid, following his death in Baqueira last December
en.summary: The partner of 72-year-old architect Josep Juanpere, who died on December 26 after hospitalization during Christmas holidays at his Val d'Aran residence, has been arrested in Madrid.

stories.title: Detenida la pareja del arquitecto Josep Juanpere por su muerte en su casa de Baqueira

en.title: Partner of architect Josep Juanpere arrested for his death at his Baqueira home
en.summary: The partner of architect Josep Juanpere, who died on December 26, 2025, has been detained in connection with his death.

stories.title: Trump y Delcy escenifican en Nueva York su alianza mientras se frustra el retorno de Machado

en.title: Trump and Delcy stage their alliance in New York while Machado's return is thwarted
en.summary: Trump and Delcy Rodríguez met in New York during the UN General Assembly reception as opposition leader María Corina Machado faced obstacles returning to Venezuela, with observers noting the meeting signals distance from democratic transition efforts.

stories.title: Detenida la mujer del arquitecto Josep Juanpere por su muerte en su casa de Baqueira

en.title: Wife of architect Josep Juanpere arrested in connection with his death at his Baqueira home
en.summary: The architect died in December 2025 and was initially attributed to natural causes. His wife has now been detained in connection with the death.

stories.title: Trump legitima a Delcy Rodríguez con un encuentro en Nueva York mientras María Corina Machado intenta en vano regresar a Venezuela

en.title: Trump legitimizes Delcy Rodríguez with a meeting in New York while María Corina Machado attempts in vain to return to Venezuela
en.summary: A Venezuelan government official met with Trump in New York, expressing gratitude for support regarding the country's reinsertion into multilateral spaces. This occurred while another Venezuelan political figure faced unsuccessful attempts to return to the country.

stories.title: Trump y Delcy Rodríguez sellan el deshielo entre Caracas y Washington con un encuentro a puerta cerrada en Nueva York

en.title: Trump and Delcy Rodríguez seal thaw between Caracas and Washington with closed-door meeting in New York
en.summary: Venezuela's leader attended Trump's UN speech where he called Maduro a "criminal dictator" and referenced Venezuela's oil as a prize to seize. The two held a private meeting afterward.

stories.title: María Corina Machado intenta entrar tres veces en Venezuela mientras Delcy Rodríguez está en la ONU

en.title: María Corina Machado attempts to enter Venezuela three times while Delcy Rodríguez is at the UN
en.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado attempted multiple entries to Venezuela using a Panamanian passport on a flight from Curaçao while the interim president attended the United Nations.

stories.title: Telefónica España crea una división de dispositivos, su gran herramienta de fidelización

en.title: Telefónica España creates a devices division as its key customer loyalty tool
en.summary: Telefónica España established a dedicated division to manage its electronics business, appointing a former Lenovo Spain executive to lead it. Device sales have become the company's primary customer retention strategy.

stories.title: El fundador de Sesderma carga en redes contra Javier Botín: "aportaré documentación"

en.title: Sesderma founder attacks Javier Botín on social media: "I will provide documentation"
en.summary: The founder of cosmetics company Sesderma made public statements against Javier Botín after JB Capital acquired a 50% stake in the company in July.

stories.title: Anthropic y OpenAI lanzan modelos más económicos en plena batalla para reducir los costes de la IA

en.title: Anthropic and OpenAI launch cheaper models amid battle to reduce AI costs
en.summary: Anthropic and OpenAI have released more economical AI models as they compete to lower artificial intelligence operational expenses. Both companies claim their models have undergone external evaluations and enhanced safety controls.

stories.title: La OCDE eleva al 2,6% el PIB de España en 2026, pero avisa de la elevada inflación

en.title: OECD raises Spain's 2026 GDP forecast to 2.6%, but warns of high inflation
en.summary: The OECD improved its growth forecast for Spain by 0.4 percentage points to 2.6% for 2026, citing global economic resilience. The organization raised its worldwide growth projection to 2.9% while cautioning about elevated inflation levels.

stories.title: La batalla entre la Reserva Federal y Donald Trump

en.title: The battle between the Federal Reserve and Donald Trump
en.summary: The excerpt examines potential tensions arising when a fundamentally strong economy faces what is characterized as an irresponsible government approach.
